tool_schemas.name: search_entries
tool_schemas.description: Searches entries within a space/environment and returns a paged list of matching entries, filtered by contentTypeId and/or workflow status, ordered by the optional order expression; pagination uses offset semantics with skip and limit (1–100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id does not match the required pattern, if status is not one of the allowed values, or if limit/skip are out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced spaceId or environmentId does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when you do not have access to the space/environment.

spaceId.description: Internal space id (spaces.id) to search within.

environmentId.description: Internal environment id (environments.id) to search within.

contentTypeId.description: Filter results to a specific internal content type id (content_types.id).

query.description: Free-text query to match against entry fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

skip.description: Number of entries to skip (offset pagination).

tool_schemas.name: create_entry
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new entry in the given environment for the specified content type and returns the created entry in draft state with the provided locale-keyed fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if environmentId/contentTypeId are malformed, fields are missing or not locale-keyed objects, or if the payload contains properties outside the schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the environment or content type does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create entries in the environment.

environmentId.description: Internal environment id (environments.id) where the entry will be created.

contentTypeId.description: Internal content type id (content_types.id) for the entry.

fields.description: Locale-aware field payload; each field key maps to an object keyed by locale (e.g., { title: { 'en-US': 'My Title' } }).

tool_schemas.name: get_entry
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single entry by entryId and returns the full entry, including its current workflow state and locale-aware fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if entryId does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if no entry exists for the given entryId, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the entry’s space/environment.

tool_schemas.name: update_entry
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing entry by merging the provided partial locale-aware fields into the entry and returns the updated entry (remaining in draft/changed state as applicable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if entryId is malformed, fields are not an object of locale-keyed values, or if the request includes additional unsupported properties. Raises NOT_FOUND if the entry does not exist, and CONFLICT if the entry is in a state that refuses edits (for example, deleted).

fields.description: Partial locale-aware field updates to merge into the existing entry (e.g., { title: { 'en-US': 'New' } }).

tool_schemas.name: delete_entry
tool_schemas.description: Deletes an entry by entryId and returns the deleted entry (or deletion result) reflecting its deleted state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if entryId does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the entry does not exist, and CONFLICT if the entry cannot be deleted due to its current state (for example, already deleted).

tool_schemas.name: publish_entry
tool_schemas.description: Publishes one entry (entryId) or bulk publishes up to 100 entries (entryIds) and returns the publish result for the single operation or the bulk operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither entryId nor entryIds is provided, if both are provided, if any id is malformed, or if entryIds exceeds 100. Raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced entry does not exist, and CONFLICT if an entry is not eligible to publish due to its current state (for example, deleted or already archived).

entryId.description: Single internal entry id (content_items.id) to publish.

entryIds.description: Multiple internal entry ids (content_items.id) to publish in bulk (max 100).

tool_schemas.name: unpublish_entry
tool_schemas.description: Unpublishes one entry (entryId) or bulk unpublishes up to 100 entries (entryIds) and returns the unpublish result for the single operation or the bulk operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither entryId nor entryIds is provided, if both are provided, if any id is malformed, or if entryIds exceeds 100. Raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced entry does not exist, and CONFLICT if an entry is not eligible to unpublish due to its current state (for example, already unpublished, deleted, or archived).

entryId.description: Single internal entry id (content_items.id) to unpublish.

entryIds.description: Multiple internal entry ids (content_items.id) to unpublish in bulk (max 100).

tool_schemas.name: list_assets
tool_schemas.description: Lists assets for a given space/environment and returns a paged collection ordered by the optional order expression; pagination is offset-based using skip and limit, with the service enforcing a maximum limit of 3 per request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or if limit/skip are out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced spaceId or environmentId does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when you do not have access to the space/environment.

spaceId.description: Internal space id (spaces.id) whose assets will be listed.

environmentId.description: Internal environment id (environments.id) whose assets will be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return (server caps at 3).

skip.description: Number of assets to skip for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: upload_asset
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new asset content item in the specified environment and returns the created asset, storing the provided locale-aware fields and asset_meta, optionally linking it to an upstream Contentful asset id and/or a content type. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if environment_id is malformed, if fields are not locale-keyed objects, if asset_meta is missing or not an object, or if unsupported properties are supplied. Raises NOT_FOUND if the environment_id does not exist (or if content_type_id is provided but does not exist), and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create assets in the environment.

environment_id.description: ID of the environment to create the asset in.

content_type_id.description: Optional content type ID if this asset is associated to a content type.

contentful_item_id.description: Optional upstream Contentful asset ID to mirror.

fields.description: Locale-aware asset fields payload (e.g., title/description per locale).

asset_meta.description: Asset metadata (e.g., file info, url, contentType, size) stored alongside fields.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def upload_asset(environment_id, fields, asset_meta, content_type_id=None, contentful_item_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0167000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0167000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, message=None, **extra):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + secrets.token_hex(12),
            "tool": "upload_asset",
            "ts": now,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        }
        if message is not None:
            row["message"] = message
        row.update(extra or {})
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # Basic rate limiting / quota (best-effort if store exists)
    def _enforce_limits():
        rl = _load("rate_limits.json")
        if not rl:
            return None
        # Find any applicable rule for this tool (or global)
        rule = None
        for r in rl:
            if r.get("tool") in (None, "", "upload_asset"):
                rule = r
                break
        if not rule:
            return None
        window_s = int(rule.get("window_seconds") or 60)
        max_req = int(rule.get("max_requests") or 0)
        if max_req <= 0:
            return None
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        # Count within window
        cutoff = datetime.datetime.utcnow() - datetime.timedelta(seconds=window_s)
        def _parse(ts):
            try:
                if ts.endswith("Z"):
                    ts = ts[:-1]
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
            except Exception:
                return None
        cnt = 0
        for e in logs:
            if e.get("tool") != "upload_asset":
                continue
            dt = _parse(e.get("ts", ""))
            if dt and dt >= cutoff:
                cnt += 1
        if cnt >= max_req:
            return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded", window_seconds=window_s, max_requests=max_req)
        return None

    limit_err = _enforce_limits()
    if limit_err:
        _log("error", limit_err["error"]["message"], error=limit_err["error"])
        return limit_err

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(environment_id, str) or not re.match(r"^cfl_env_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", environment_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "environment_id is malformed", field="environment_id")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e
    if content_type_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(content_type_id, str) or not re.match(r"^cfl_ct_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", content_type_id):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content_type_id is malformed", field="content_type_id")
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
            return e
    if contentful_item_id is not None and not isinstance(contentful_item_id, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "contentful_item_id must be a string", field="contentful_item_id")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(fields, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "fields must be an object", field="fields")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(asset_meta, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "asset_meta must be an object", field="asset_meta")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e

    spaces = _load("spaces.json")
    envs = _load("environments.json")
    cts = _load("content_types.json")
    items = _load("content_items.json")

    env = next((r for r in envs if r.get("id") == environment_id), None)
    if not env:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Environment not found", environment_id=environment_id)
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e

    if env.get("status") != "ready":
        e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Environment is not ready", environment_status=env.get("status"))
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"], environment_id=environment_id)
        return e

    space = next((s for s in spaces if s.get("id") == env.get("space_id")), None)
    if not space:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No accessible space for this environment")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"], environment_id=environment_id)
        return e
    if space.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Space is not active", space_status=space.get("status"))
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"], space_id=space.get("id"))
        return e

    available_locales = space.get("available_locales") or []
    if not isinstance(available_locales, list) or not available_locales:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Space has no available locales configured")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"], space_id=space.get("id"))
        return e

    # Validate locale-keyed structure for fields: each provided field must be a dict keyed by locales,
    # and must not omit locale keys (at least one locale key; and each key must be enabled).
    for fid, v in fields.items():
        if not isinstance(fid, str) or fid.strip() == "":
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Field ids must be non-empty strings", field_id=fid)
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
            return e
        if not isinstance(v, dict):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Each field value must be an object keyed by locale", field=fid)
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
            return e
        if len(v) == 0:
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Field value must include locale keys", field=fid)
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
            return e
        for loc in v.keys():
            if loc not in available_locales:
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsupported locale key for this space", field=fid, locale=loc)
                _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
                return e

    # Validate optional content_type_id exists in same environment if provided.
    internal_ct_id = None
    if content_type_id is not None:
        ct = next((r for r in cts if r.get("environment_id") == environment_id and r.get("contentful_content_type_id") == content_type_id and r.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
        if not ct:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Content type not found in environment", environment_id=environment_id, content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
            return e
        internal_ct_id = ct.get("id")

    # Determine contentful_item_id; if absent generate. Enforce uniqueness.
    def _gen_item_id():
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        return "cfl_item_" + "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(22))

    chosen_contentful_item_id = contentful_item_id or _gen_item_id()
    if not isinstance(chosen_contentful_item_id, str) or chosen_contentful_item_id.strip() == "":
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "contentful_item_id must be a non-empty string when provided", field="contentful_item_id")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e

    # unique(environment_id, type, contentful_item_id)
    exists = next((r for r in items if r.get("environment_id") == environment_id and r.get("type") == "asset" and r.get("contentful_item_id") == chosen_contentful_item_id), None)
    if exists and exists.get("status") != "deleted":
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Asset with this contentful_item_id already exists in environment", contentful_item_id=chosen_contentful_item_id)
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e
    if exists and exists.get("status") == "deleted":
        # Contentful-like behavior can treat as conflict; we choose conflict (id reuse not allowed)
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Asset id already used (deleted)", contentful_item_id=chosen_contentful_item_id)
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], error=e["error"])
        return e

    def _gen_internal_id():
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        return "cfl_item_" + "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(22))

    internal_id = _gen_internal_id()
    while any(r.get("id") == internal_id for r in items):
        internal_id = _gen_internal_id()

    new_row = {
        "id": internal_id,
        "environment_id": environment_id,
        "type": "asset",
        "content_type_id": None,          # assets must have null content_type_id per schema constraints
        "contentful_item_id": chosen_contentful_item_id,
        "fields": fields,
        "asset_meta": asset_meta,
        "sys_version": 1,
        "published_version": None,
        "published_at": None,
        "first_published_at": None,
        "status": "draft",
        "deleted_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    # Enforce asset constraint: content_type_id must be null; if provided content_type_id acts as association only
    # but cannot be stored in content_items.content_type_id for assets per schema. We include it in response meta.
    items.append(new_row)
    _save("content_items.json", items)

    resp = {"asset": new_row, "meta": {"environment_id": environment_id, "space_id": space.get("id")}}
    if internal_ct_id is not None:
        resp["meta"]["associated_content_type_internal_id"] = internal_ct_id
        resp["meta"]["associated_contentful_content_type_id"] = content_type_id

    _log("ok", environment_id=environment_id, asset_id=internal_id)
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: get_asset
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single asset by asset_id and returns the full asset, including its locale-aware fields and stored metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if asset_id does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if no asset exists for the given asset_id, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the asset’s space/environment.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset content item to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update_asset
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Asset’s locale-aware fields and/or asset metadata and returns the updated Asset, incrementing its sys version. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if asset_id is malformed, if fields/asset_meta are not objects, or if disallowed properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the Asset does not exist or is deleted; raises VERSION_MISMATCH if sys_version is provided and does not match the current Asset version.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset content item to update.

asset_meta.description: Updated asset metadata (e.g., file info, url, contentType, size).

sys_version.description: Current sys version for optimistic concurrency control.

tool_schemas.name: delete_asset
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes an Asset and returns the deleted Asset (or a deletion acknowledgement, depending on client), making it unavailable for subsequent reads and state changes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if asset_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the Asset does not exist or is already deleted; raises CONFLICT if the Asset is currently published and must be unpublished before it can be deleted.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset content item to delete (soft delete).

tool_schemas.name: publish_asset
tool_schemas.description: Publishes an Asset by promoting the current draft to the published state and returns the published Asset with updated sys metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if asset_id is malformed or sys_version is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the Asset does not exist or is deleted; raises VERSION_MISMATCH if sys_version is provided and does not match the current version; raises CONFLICT if the Asset is already published.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset content item to publish.

sys_version.description: Current sys version to publish from (optimistic concurrency).

tool_schemas.name: unpublish_asset
tool_schemas.description: Unpublishes an Asset by removing its published state while keeping the draft, and returns the updated Asset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if asset_id is malformed or sys_version is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the Asset does not exist or is deleted; raises VERSION_MISMATCH if sys_version is provided and does not match the current version; raises CONFLICT if the Asset is not currently published.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset content item to unpublish.

sys_version.description: Current sys version for optimistic concurrency control.

tool_schemas.name: list_content_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists Content Types in the given Space (optionally scoped to an Environment) and returns a paged collection with up to 10 items per request; use skip to advance through the result set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if space_id/environment_id formats are invalid or skip is negative; raises NOT_FOUND if the Space does not exist, or if environment_id is provided and that Environment does not exist within the Space; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the Space/Environment.

space_id.description: ID of the space to list content types for.

environment_id.description: Optional environment ID to scope the content types (if omitted, lists across the space when supported).

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: get_content_type
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Content Type by ID and returns its full definition, including fields schema and sys metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content_type_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the Content Type does not exist or has been deleted; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the Content Type’s space/environment.

content_type_id.description: ID of the content type to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_content_type
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Content Type in the specified Environment and returns the created Content Type with its sys metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if environment_id is malformed, if required properties (name, fields_schema) are missing/invalid, or if display_field does not refer to a field in the provided schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the Environment does not exist; raises CONFLICT if a Content Type with the same external contentful_content_type_id already exists in that Environment (when provided).

environment_id.description: ID of the environment to create the content type in.

contentful_content_type_id.description: External Contentful content type identifier to mirror (if applicable).

name.description: Human-readable name of the content type.

display_field.description: Field ID to use as the display field for entries of this content type.

fields_schema.description: JSON schema/definition for the content type fields.

tool_schemas.name: update_content_type
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Content Type by merging the provided properties (including partial fields_schema) into the current definition, and returns the updated Content Type with an incremented sys version. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content_type_id is malformed, if provided values are invalid, or if display_field does not refer to a field in the resulting merged schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the Content Type does not exist or is deleted; raises VERSION_MISMATCH if sys_version is provided and does not match the current version; raises CONFLICT if the Content Type is published and the requested update is not allowed without first unpublishing.

content_type_id.description: ID of the content type to update.

contentful_content_type_id.description: External Contentful content type identifier to set/update.

name.description: Updated human-readable name of the content type.

description.description: Updated description of the content type.

display_field.description: Updated field ID to use as the display field.

fields_schema.description: Partial or full updated fields schema; merged with existing content type data.

sys_version.description: Current system version for optimistic concurrency control.

tool_schemas.name: delete_content_type
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a Content Type and returns the deleted Content Type (or a deletion acknowledgement, depending on client). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content_type_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the Content Type does not exist or is already deleted; raises CONFLICT if the Content Type is published and must be unpublished before deletion.

content_type_id.description: ID of the content type to delete.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def delete_content_type(content_type_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0167000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0167000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "delete_content_type"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, credential_used=None, error=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{random.randint(1000,9999)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_used": credential_used,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "timestamp": _now()
        }
        if error is not None:
            row["error"] = error
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    try:
        if not isinstance(content_type_id, str) or not re.match(r"^cfl_ct_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{18,}$", content_type_id):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content_type_id is malformed.", field="content_type_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        cts = _load("content_types.json")
        envs = _load("environments.json")
        spaces = _load("spaces.json")

        idx = next((i for i, x in enumerate(cts) if x.get("id") == content_type_id), None)
        if idx is None:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Content Type not found.", content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        ct = cts[idx]
        if ct.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Content Type is already deleted.", content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        env = next((x for x in envs if x.get("id") == ct.get("environment_id")), None)
        space = next((s for s in spaces if s.get("id") == (env.get("space_id") if env else None)), None)
        if env is None or space is None or space.get("status") != "active" or env.get("status") != "ready":
            e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No accessible active space/ready environment combination can serve this request.")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        if ct.get("status") == "published":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Published Content Types must be unpublished before deletion.", content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        # lifecycle transition to deleted allowed from draft/archived only per schema
        if ct.get("status") not in ("draft", "archived"):
            e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Cannot delete Content Type from current status.", from_status=ct.get("status"), to_status="deleted")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        deleted = dict(ct)
        deleted["status"] = "deleted"
        deleted["updated_at"] = _now()
        deleted["sys_version"] = int(deleted.get("sys_version") or 0) + 1
        if deleted["sys_version"] < 1:
            deleted["sys_version"] = 1

        cts[idx] = deleted
        _save("content_types.json", cts)
        _log("ok")
        return {"content_type": deleted}
    except Exception as ex:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unexpected error.", details=str(ex))
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

tool_schemas.name: publish_content_type
tool_schemas.description: Publishes a Content Type and returns the published Content Type with updated sys metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content_type_id is malformed or sys_version is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the Content Type does not exist or is deleted; raises VERSION_MISMATCH if sys_version is provided and does not match the current version; raises CONFLICT if the Content Type is already published or cannot be published due to invalid or incomplete schema (for example, an invalid display_field).

content_type_id.description: ID of the content type to publish.

sys_version.description: Current system version for optimistic concurrency control.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def publish_content_type(content_type_id, sys_version=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0167000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0167000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "publish_content_type"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, credential_used=None, error=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{random.randint(1000,9999)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_used": credential_used,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "timestamp": _now()
        }
        if error is not None:
            row["error"] = error
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    try:
        if not isinstance(content_type_id, str) or not re.match(r"^cfl_ct_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{18,}$", content_type_id):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content_type_id is malformed.", field="content_type_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        if sys_version is not None and not isinstance(sys_version, int):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sys_version must be an integer when provided.", field="sys_version")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        cts = _load("content_types.json")
        envs = _load("environments.json")
        spaces = _load("spaces.json")

        idx = next((i for i, x in enumerate(cts) if x.get("id") == content_type_id), None)
        if idx is None:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Content Type not found.", content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        ct = cts[idx]
        if ct.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Content Type is deleted.", content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        env = next((x for x in envs if x.get("id") == ct.get("environment_id")), None)
        space = next((s for s in spaces if s.get("id") == (env.get("space_id") if env else None)), None)
        if env is None or space is None or space.get("status") != "active" or env.get("status") != "ready":
            e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No accessible active space/ready environment combination can serve this request.")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        if sys_version is not None and sys_version != ct.get("sys_version"):
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "sys_version does not match current version.", expected=ct.get("sys_version"), provided=sys_version)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        if ct.get("status") == "published":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Content Type is already published.", content_type_id=content_type_id)
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        # Business rule: publish allowed only when status='draft' and schema is valid
        if ct.get("status") != "draft":
            e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Content Type can only be published from draft.", from_status=ct.get("status"), to_status="published")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        schema = ct.get("fields_schema")
        if not isinstance(schema, dict):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "fields_schema must be an object to publish.", field="fields_schema")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        fields_list = schema.get("fields")
        if fields_list is None:
            fields_list = []
        if not isinstance(fields_list, list):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "fields_schema.fields must be an array.", field="fields_schema.fields")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        field_ids = set()
        for i, f in enumerate(fields_list):
            if not isinstance(f, dict):
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Each field definition must be an object.", field=f"fields_schema.fields[{i}]")
                _log("error", error=e["error"])
                return e
            fid = f.get("id")
            if not isinstance(fid, str) or fid.strip() == "":
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Each field must have a non-empty string id.", field=f"fields_schema.fields[{i}].id")
                _log("error", error=e["error"])
                return e
            field_ids.add(fid)
        if ct.get("display_field") is not None and ct.get("display_field") not in field_ids:
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "display_field must refer to a field id present in fields_schema.", field="display_field")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

        published = dict(ct)
        published["published_version"] = published.get("sys_version")
        published["status"] = "published"
        published["updated_at"] = _now()

        cts[idx] = published
        _save("content_types.json", cts)
        _log("ok")
        return {"content_type": published}
    except Exception as ex:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unexpected error.", details=str(ex))
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

tool_schemas.name: list_spaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists spaces visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status and sorted by the requested order, returning a paged collection with up to `limit` items and a `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `limit`, `order`, or `status` are invalid or `cursor` is malformed, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller cannot access spaces. Raises `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if the request exceeds configured rate or listing limits.

limit.description: Maximum number of spaces to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_space
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single space by `space_id` and returns its full details. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `space_id` does not match the required format, `NOT_FOUND` if no such space exists, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller is not permitted to view it. Raises `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if the request exceeds configured rate limits.

space_id.description: ID of the space to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_environments
tool_schemas.description: Lists environments within the specified space, optionally filtered by status and sorted by the requested order, returning a paged collection with up to `limit` items and a `cursor` for the next page. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `space_id` is invalid or if `limit`, `order`, `status`, or `cursor` are invalid, and `NOT_FOUND` if the space does not exist. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller cannot access the space, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if the request exceeds configured rate or listing limits.

space_id.description: ID of the space whose environments will be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of environments to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_environment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new environment in the given space and returns the created environment, initially in `creating` and progressing to `ready` when available. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `space_id` is invalid, `name` is missing/empty, or `contentful_environment_id` is invalid when provided, and `NOT_FOUND` if the space does not exist. Raises `CONFLICT` if an environment with the same identifier already exists in the space or if the space is not in a state that allows environment creation, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` or `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when access or quotas prevent creation.

space_id.description: ID of the space to create the environment in.

contentful_environment_id.description: External Contentful environment identifier to mirror (if applicable).

tool_schemas.name: delete_environment
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified environment and returns the deleted environment (or a deletion confirmation) with status transitioning to `deleting`/`deleted`. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `environment_id` is not in the expected format, `NOT_FOUND` if the environment does not exist, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller cannot manage it. Raises `CONFLICT` if the environment cannot be deleted due to its current status (for example already `deleting`/`deleted`) or active dependent operations, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if rate limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: bulk_validate
tool_schemas.description: Validates multiple entry items in an environment and returns per-entry validation results, optionally limited to the provided locale codes (otherwise all locales present are validated). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `environment_id`/any `entry_ids` are invalid, `entry_ids` is empty, locales are empty/invalid, or if any referenced item is not an entry, and `NOT_FOUND` if the environment does not exist or any entry ID cannot be found in that environment. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller cannot read the environment or entries, and `CONFLICT` if entries are in a state that cannot be validated (for example deleted), with `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when bulk limits or rate limits are exceeded.

environment_id.description: Environment containing the entries to validate (environments.id).

entry_ids.description: List of entry content item IDs to validate (content_items.id where type='entry').

locales.description: Optional list of locale codes to validate (defaults to all locales present).

tool_schemas.name: list_ai_actions
tool_schemas.description: Lists AI Actions in a space, optionally restricted to a single environment and filtered by status, returning a paged collection with up to `limit` items and a `cursor` for the next page. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `space_id`/`environment_id` are invalid or if `limit`, `order`, `status`, or `cursor` are invalid, and `NOT_FOUND` if the space does not exist or the provided environment is not found in that space. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller cannot access the space/environment, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if rate or listing limits are exceeded.

space_id.description: Space to list AI Actions for (spaces.id).

environment_id.description: If provided, restrict results to a single environment (environments.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of AI Actions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single AI Action by `ai_action_id` and returns its stored definition and metadata. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `ai_action_id` is not in the expected format, `NOT_FOUND` if the AI Action does not exist, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller cannot access it. Raises `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if the request exceeds configured rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: create_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Creates an AI Action in the specified environment and returns the created action, including its stored definition payload. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `environment_id` is invalid, `name` is empty, or `definition` is missing/invalid, and `NOT_FOUND` if the environment does not exist. Raises `CONFLICT` if an AI Action with the same name/identifier already exists in the environment or if the environment is not in a state that permits creation, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` or `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when access or quotas prevent creation.

environment_id.description: Environment in which to create the AI Action (environments.id).

definition.description: AI Action definition payload stored for invocation/execution.

tool_schemas.name: update_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing AI Action and returns the updated action, applying optimistic concurrency using `sys_version`. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `ai_action_id` is invalid, `sys_version` is missing/invalid, or provided fields fail validation, and `NOT_FOUND` if the AI Action does not exist. Raises `CONFLICT` if `sys_version` does not match the current version, or if the action is in a state that refuses updates (for example `deleted`), and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` or `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when access or rate limits prevent the update.

sys_version.description: Current system version for optimistic concurrency control (ai_actions.sys_version).

tool_schemas.name: delete_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified AI Action and returns the deleted AI Action record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ai_action_id is missing or does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if no AI Action exists for that id, and CONFLICT if the AI Action cannot be deleted because it is currently published or otherwise not in a deletable state. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to manage AI Actions.

tool_schemas.name: publish_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Publishes the specified AI Action and returns the updated AI Action with its published state and version metadata updated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ai_action_id is invalid or sys_version is missing/less than 1, NOT_FOUND if the AI Action does not exist, and VERSION_MISMATCH (409) if sys_version does not match the current ai_actions.sys_version. Raises CONFLICT if the AI Action is already published or cannot be published from its current state, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to publish AI Actions.

sys_version.description: Current system version for optimistic concurrency control prior to publishing (ai_actions.sys_version).

tool_schemas.name: unpublish_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Unpublishes the specified AI Action in the given Environment and returns the updated AI Action reflecting the unpublished state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ai_action_id or environment_id are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the Environment does not exist or the AI Action is not found in that Environment, and VERSION_MISMATCH (409) if sys_version is provided and does not match the current sys_version. Raises CONFLICT if the AI Action is not currently published (or cannot be unpublished from its current state), and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to unpublish AI Actions.

ai_action_id.description: ID of the AI Action to unpublish (internal primary key).

environment_id.description: ID of the Environment that owns the AI Action.

sys_version.description: Expected current sys_version for optimistic concurrency control.

tool_schemas.name: invoke_ai_action
tool_schemas.description: Invokes the specified AI Action in the given Environment with the provided variables and returns an AI Action invocation record that can be retrieved later (the variables are stored as request_variables). If idempotency_key is provided, repeated requests with the same key for the same action/environment return the existing invocation rather than creating a new one. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ai_action_id, environment_id, or variables are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the Environment or AI Action does not exist in that Environment, CONFLICT if the AI Action is not in an invokable state, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to invoke AI Actions.

ai_action_id.description: ID of the AI Action to invoke (internal primary key).

environment_id.description: ID of the Environment in which to invoke the AI Action.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-provided key to deduplicate repeated invocation requests.

tool_schemas.name: get_ai_action_invocation
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the AI Action invocation record, including its stored request_variables and any recorded result/status, for the given Environment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ai_action_invocation_id or environment_id are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the Environment does not exist or the invocation is not found in that Environment, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to view AI Action invocations. Raises CONFLICT if the invocation exists but its result is not available due to an invalid or disallowed state transition.

ai_action_invocation_id.description: ID of the AI Action invocation to retrieve.

environment_id.description: ID of the Environment that owns the invocation.

tool_schemas.name: create_space
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new space and returns the created space in active status. Refuses requests with invalid locale configuration, duplicate contentful_space_id within the caller’s scope, or unsupported properties.

contentfulSpaceId.description: External Contentful space id mirrored into contentful_space_id.

availableLocales.description: List of enabled locales for entries/assets in this space; must include defaultLocale.

tool_schemas.name: update_space
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable space properties and/or performs a lifecycle transition via status, then returns the updated space. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., deleted -> active), invalid locale updates, or attempts to modify immutable identifiers.

defaultLocale.description: Updated default locale; must be included in availableLocales.

availableLocales.description: Updated list of enabled locales; must include defaultLocale. Writes affecting locale availability may be refused if they would invalidate existing content.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the space. Only allowed transitions are enforced.
